symptom: The exported untrusted source-manifest reference digest appended decision and outcome digest fields using fields[fields.length] assignment. A synthetic inherited Array.prototype numeric setter at index 7 could discard every appended field and make distinct manifests with equal decision counts hash identically. A separate index-10 setter could drop the first outcome digest. Node 22.16.0 synthetic probes reproduced the alias; no independent evidence or production data was used.
lesson: Length-prefixing and SHA-256 do not preserve source-manifest identity if ambient prototype setters can intercept construction of the fields array before hashing. Validated detached inputs still require own-index output writes when assembling the digest transcript.
guardrail: Append each validated decision digest, outcome count and outcome digest using Object.defineProperty on a fresh fields array, not fields[fields.length] or mutable push. Regression-test distinct synthetic decision and outcome manifests under reversible inherited setters at first-decision index 7 and first-outcome index 10; assert unchanged baseline digests, no setter invocation and no scoring/production authority.
